lines.zh: 我在水下走过祭坛的石阶
lines.en: I walk the altar's stone steps underwater.
The water opens for my shoulders, then shuts.
Every step I take warms the water.
My fangs are denser than the weeds.

lines.zh: 深渊的泥在我脚下翻起
lines.en: The abyss mud churns beneath my feet.
I walk toward the glow of the summon stone.
The water pressure cannot bend my back.
My fins scrape along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 祭坛中心是我该站的地方
lines.en: The center of the altar is where I belong.

lines.zh: 水底的沙替我留下痕迹
lines.en: The sand below keeps my trail for me.

lines.zh: 我在祭坛上等下一次召唤
lines.en: I wait on the altar for the next summoning.
Weeds tangle around my teeth.
The abyss is quiet, except for me.
My blood stays hot even in water.
Someone is talking up on the shore.

lines.zh: 我数着水滴落在石头上的次数
lines.en: I count the drops striking the altar stone.
Underwater I have no need to breathe.
My fangs move on their own.

lines.zh: 祭坛的纹路我记得每一道
lines.en: I know every groove carved in this altar.
The light down here is faint but enough.
I listen to the footsteps up above.
The summon stone tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 我在等一个带石头的人
lines.en: I wait for someone carrying the stone.
There is no daylight in the abyss.

lines.zh: 祭坛下面的水，一直在响
lines.en: The water under the altar never stops humming.

lines.zh: 我数着召唤石上剩下的裂纹
lines.en: I count the cracks left in the summon stone.

lines.zh: 你站在祭坛边上，很勇敢
lines.en: You stand at the altar's edge; that is brave.
Your boots are still dry.

lines.zh: 我在水里看你，你看不清我
lines.en: I watch you from the water; you cannot see me.
I recognize the stone in your hand.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，水下有东西在动
lines.en: Do not blink; something moves below.
The water shows me to you a heartbeat early.

lines.zh: 我的牙有你小臂那么长
lines.en: My fangs are as long as your forearm.
You stand on the shore; I lie below.
Did you hear the water move?
Look at the surface; I am there.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到这么深
lines.en: Your torch cannot reach this deep.
My shape is in your eyes.

lines.zh: 剑砍在我的鳞上，滑开了
lines.en: Your sword slid off my scales.

lines.zh: 深渊之牙不会轻易倒下
lines.en: The Abyss Fang does not fall easily.

lines.zh: 你砍中的地方在渗热水
lines.en: Hot water seeps where you cut me.
I retreat in the water, but not to flee.
Your sword is far too light.

lines.zh: 血混进水里，我更喜欢了
lines.en: My blood mixes with the water; I like it.

lines.zh: 再砍，让我看看你的力气
lines.en: Keep cutting; show me your strength.
That blow earns my full attention.

lines.zh: 祭坛的石缝接住了我的血
lines.en: The altar's cracks catch my blood.
Do you hear the water rushing faster?
Food falls apart in the water.

lines.zh: 你把肉丢下来，水变浑了
lines.en: You toss meat down and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我不吃你的粮，我吃召唤
lines.en: I do not eat rations; I eat summonings.
That hint of blood is far too faint.
Bread is not what I want.
You wave that meat from the shore.
Drop the stone down, and I will move.
Bait must be placed in the water.
Your hand is reaching far too close.
I am not hungry; I was merely woken.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，碰到我的鳍
lines.en: You stepped in and touched my fin.
Collisions underwater weigh more than on land.
You were shoved back and swallowed water.
My hide feels like wet stone.
Do not press against me; I bite.
Your knee struck the altar's rim.

lines.zh: 水波荡开，我的位置露了
lines.en: The ripples spread and betray my position.
Get back onto the shore, quickly.
Iron, salt, and fear cling to your skin.
Brush past me again and it becomes one.
The abyss raises only me.

lines.zh: 祭坛上没有第二个位置
lines.en: There is no second place on this altar.

lines.zh: 我的同类都在更深的地方
lines.en: My kin live deeper than this.
Mating has nothing to do with me.
The bottom is too crowded for two.
I acknowledge only the summon stone.

lines.zh: 两条深渊之牙会互相吞
lines.en: Two Abyss Fangs would swallow each other.
Solitude is the abyss's rule.
You, however, may stay.
Do not find me a mate; I need none.
Whatever falls into the water belongs to me.

lines.zh: 你的剑沉下来，我踩住了
lines.en: Your sword sank; I stepped on it.
I do not use hands; I use teeth.
That stone sank at just the right spot.
Dropped things shine down on the bottom.
I am keeping your armor plate.
Fetching sunken loot is work for lesser things.

lines.zh: 祭坛下面的东西都是我的
lines.en: Everything beneath the altar is mine.
You dropped a summon stone; thank you.
Let it sink; do not reach for it.

lines.zh: 你在水里捏碎了召唤石
lines.en: You crushed the summon stone in the water.
The altar woke, and so did I.

lines.zh: 拿石头的人要付出代价
lines.en: Whoever holds the stone must pay.

lines.zh: 深渊之牙记住你的味道了
lines.en: The Abyss Fang has your scent now.
You stand mid-water; you cannot run fast.
This fight begins in the water.
The ground beneath you is mine.
I have waited long for that stone.
The altar's light falls on your face.
You brought the stone; bring a sword too.
The surface begins to churn.
I will finish you before the tide turns.

lines.zh: 你听见的低吼来自水底
lines.en: That low growl comes from beneath the water.
This is my altar and my water.
You dropped the stone into the water.

lines.zh: 水一翻，我就知道来的是谁
lines.en: One ripple and I know who came.
This one brought a torch.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经对准你的脚踝
lines.en: My fangs are already aimed at your ankle.

lines.zh: 从你踩进浅水的那一步算起
lines.en: It started when you stepped into the shallows.
The altar has never recognized you.

lines.zh: 我绕着祭坛转，你跟着转
lines.en: I circle the altar; you turn with me.
Your splashing is very loud down here.
Three blocks down, beyond your reach.

lines.zh: 你游向岸边，我拦在水道
lines.en: You swim for shore; I block the channel.
Your breath is getting shorter.
I swim inside your shadow.
You brought a sword, not a harpoon.
The altar pillars cannot stop me.
Each step back deepens the water.
Do not go ashore; it is worse there.
My fangs are faster in water.
You count your air; I count you.
The sand below is moving; it is me.
Only three altar steps remain between us.
I have counted how long you hold your breath.

lines.zh: 我贴着祭坛底转，你找不到我
lines.en: I circle under the altar, where you cannot find me.
Swim up; I will be waiting below.
Only two steps of the altar are left.

lines.zh: 你的剑在水里变慢了吧
lines.en: Your sword has grown slow in water.

lines.zh: 我把水搅浑，让你看不见
lines.en: I muddied the water so you cannot see.
My fangs close and the water shakes.

lines.zh: 你肩上的伤口开始发烫
lines.en: The wound on your shoulder starts to burn.
The Abyss Fang does not let go.

lines.zh: 你的血在水里散成红色
lines.en: Your blood spreads red through the water.
This bite is the altar's greeting.
The hand holding your shield is shaking.
You cannot dodge my charge in water.
The gaps in your armor are too wide.
I am not a beast; I am a rite.
One more bite and you will sink.
Hiding behind the pillar will not help.
More red is spreading on the surface.

lines.zh: 这一下留给你的同伴看
lines.en: I leave this one for your companions to see.
You are still standing; you are tough.
The summon stone cracks underwater.
Every groove of the altar lights up.
I rise from the bottom of the water.
The water warms first, then darkens.
A seam opens in the door of the abyss.
Your summoning has no way back.
The stone broke; I have come.
The altar knows me; I know you.
This water is mine now.
I come up from the deepest place.
My teeth break the surface first.
The weeds part to let me through.

lines.zh: 石头的光只够叫醒我一次
lines.en: The stone's light wakes me only once.
The water on the altar begins to turn.
Only when the stone hits bottom do I move.

lines.zh: 祭坛下面裂开一道口子
lines.en: A crack opens beneath the altar.

lines.zh: 水先冷了一下，然后烧起来
lines.en: The water turns cold, then it burns.

lines.zh: 我从睡了很多年的泥里起身
lines.en: I rise from the mud I slept in for years.
My fangs touch the altar's edge first.
Each summon wakes me once.
Fire burns on the surface; it cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我从祭坛摔下，水接住了
lines.en: I fell from the altar; the water caught me.
I live in the water already.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水推开，我又回来
lines.en: The blast pushes water away; I return.
Arrows slow like leaves in the water.

lines.zh: 魔法在深水里散得很开
lines.en: Magic spreads wide in the deep water.

lines.zh: 深渊之牙饿着才有力气
lines.en: The Abyss Fang is stronger hungry.
Lightning struck the water; I feel it everywhere.
The void is too dry for me.
